verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet offers a customizable Trust Center that customers set up and publish. Nothing documents the Trust Center syncing itself from the platform: no automatic subprocessor lists, no document-renewal updates, and no live control-status display. Real-time monitors and scheduled evidence collection are separate compliance features and do not show that the Trust Center updates on its own.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
